Tony Marino has been the bassist of choice for a number of significant jazz artists, including Joe Lovano, Dave Liebman and Phil Woods. He honed his skills as a house bassist in venues throughout the Poconos and Catskills.
Tony was interviewed via Zoom on August 25, 2025 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
